tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: Wada's ivory paper in light, warm charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs — anything that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, quoted source passages, table headers, code blocks, input fills: a warm parchment grey (paper with a tenth of khaki) in light, warm near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Background of a hovered or keyboard-highlighted row, option, menu item or quiet button. `ink` (10.3:1 light, 13.6:1 dark) and `ink-muted` (5.2:1, 6.5:1) read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` (dark: 4.2:1 and 3.9:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token. In light it is Wada's Slate Color (#1b3644).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions on every surface token.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand's one hue — Raw Sienna. Primary buttons, selected states, key marks. Fill only; pair with `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on surface tokens.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for selected rows, highlights; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button background on hover, replacing `accent`. Text on it is `on-accent` (5.9:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind a modal Dialog, over the whole page. Never under text.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Olive Green, the combination's second hue. Secondary emphasis, tags, the second series in a chart. Pair with `on-secondary`.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `secondary`.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for secondary tags; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset — Helvetia Blue in light, Salvia Blue in dark. Reserved for focus; never decoration.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions — Carmine Red / Vinaceous Cinnamon. Text on surfaces, or a fill with `on-status`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and passed checks — Dusky Green / Rainette Green. Always with a word or icon; never told from `danger` by hue alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-review states — Orange Citrine / Yellow Ocher. Text on surfaces, or a fill with `on-status`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices — slate, so it never competes with the evidence bands. Always with an 'i' icon or the word 'Note'.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger`, `success`, `warning` or `info` fill.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (Raw Sienna).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series (Slate Color / Light Glaucous Blue).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series (Olive Green).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth data series (Antwarp Blue / Cerulian Blue).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth data series (Vistoris Lake / Light Brown Drab).

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: Evidence band: what a preserved source states (OBSERVED, ASSERTED, reported). Text and solid 1.5px edges on surface tokens; the same ink as body text, because evidence is the ground truth everything else is measured against.

tokens.name: evidence-soft
tokens.usage: Background of evidence chips and source-span highlights; text on it is `evidence`.

tokens.name: allegation
tokens.usage: Allegation band: narrative claims a source makes that are not established (ALLEGED, DENIED). Text and long-dash edges on surface tokens. Never shown in `evidence` ink — an allegation must never look like a fact.

tokens.name: allegation-soft
tokens.usage: Background of allegation chips; text on it is `allegation`.

tokens.name: derived
tokens.usage: Platform-derived band: deterministic results the platform computed (RESOLVED identities, DERIVED graph relationships, screening hits). Text and short-dash edges on surface tokens.

tokens.name: derived-soft
tokens.usage: Background of derived chips; text on it is `derived`.

tokens.name: model
tokens.usage: Model band: probabilistic output (INFERRED, PREDICTED, agent proposals). Text and dotted edges on surface tokens; always shown with its probability or confidence and the word 'predicted' or 'inferred'.

tokens.name: model-soft
tokens.usage: Background of model chips; text on it is `model`.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Human-decision band: HUMAN_VERIFIED findings and approved decisions — what a named person accepted under a named policy. Text, double-line edges and the approver mark on surface tokens.

tokens.name: verified-soft
tokens.usage: Background of verified chips; text on it is `verified`.

tokens.name: rejected
tokens.usage: REJECTED or superseded findings: kept and shown, struck through, never deleted. Text 24px+ or with strikethrough plus the word 'Rejected'; for body-size text use `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: sensitive
tokens.usage: Sensitivity label fill (victim data, data about minors, special-category data): an inverse slate banner or chip, told apart by form, the lock icon and the label text rather than by an alarm colour. Pair with `on-sensitive`.

tokens.name: on-sensitive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sensitive`.

tokens.name: quarantine
tokens.usage: Hatch stripes of the quarantined-content placeholder (Safegress): diagonal stripes on `surface-sunken` where withheld content would be, with a solid `surface-raised` label carrying `on-quarantine` text. Never show a thumbnail or excerpt.

tokens.name: on-quarantine
tokens.usage: Text on the quarantine placeholder's label (`surface-raised`).

tokens.name: redaction
tokens.usage: Redacted spans inside source text: a solid bar the width of the span, with its placeholder label ('redacted person 17') in `caption`.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, lowest step (exposure, concentration, purity). Light grounds run light→dark; dark grounds run dark→light.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, step 3 (Raw Sienna).

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, highest step.

tokens.name: conf-1
tokens.usage: Model-confidence scale (khaki, the model band's hue), lowest band (probability under 0.2). Used only for model outputs; evidence has no confidence colour.

tokens.name: conf-2
tokens.usage: Model-confidence scale, 0.2–0.4.

tokens.name: conf-3
tokens.usage: Model-confidence scale, 0.4–0.6.

tokens.name: conf-4
tokens.usage: Model-confidence scale, 0.6–0.8.

tokens.name: conf-5
tokens.usage: Model-confidence scale, 0.8 and above.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, strongly below reference (e.g. holdings far under the stated strategy in the Narrative Drift Monitor).

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, below reference.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging scale midpoint: on reference, no drift.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, above reference.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, strongly above reference.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Roboto, for every heading and the wordmark. Weights 500 and 700.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: covers, landing headers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, table headers.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Didact Gothic, for everything you read. It has one weight (400): emphasise with Roboto `label` or `subheading`, never faux bold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every claim traces to the exact passage that supports it.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for code and figures that must align.
